message.content: This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large, pink, serif letters. Below the title, black text reads "SAATNYA JABAT TANGAN". The background is a pale green field with horizontal white lines resembling a sports pitch. Two men stand facing away from each other but looking back over their shoulders. On the left, a man with a heavy build and dark hair wears a maroon athletic jersey with white accents. The jersey has the word "JOKOWI" and the number "2" printed in white on the back. He is lifting the hem of his shirt with his left hand, revealing white shorts and part of his torso. On the right, a man with a slimmer build and short dark hair wears a white athletic jersey with maroon accents. His jersey has "PRABOWO" and the number "1" printed in black on the back. He has his right hand near his collar. Both men are drawn in a realistic caricature style. At the top, several headlines in black text are visible, including "BISNIS HIJAB GO INTERNATIONAL". At the bottom left, there is a barcode and price information.
